title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what personal data Vibed collects, why, who processes it, how long it is kept and how you can exercise your rights. It applies to the Vibed website, the editor and the emails we send.
In short: we use your data to run the service you signed up for. We do not sell it, we do not show ads, and we do not use your videos to train AI models.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
blocks: The data controller is {{ownerName}}, {{legalForm}}, trading as {{tradeName}}.
We have not appointed a data protection officer, as the law does not require one for a business of our size. Every privacy question or request goes to the email address above.

sections.title: 2. The data we collect
blocks: **Account.** Your email address, your name if you give it, and your password, which is stored in hashed form by our authentication provider. We never see it in clear text.
**Your content.** The videos, audio files and images you upload, the projects you create (timeline, captions, text, settings), the files you export and the thumbnails we generate.

**Analysis of your content.** To power the editing features, we create transcripts, speaker labels ("Speaker 1", "Speaker 2"), scene descriptions, the position of faces in the frame and similar technical data. These results are stored with your project.
**Instructions to the assistant.** The requests you type to the AI assistant, its answers, and a record of which suggestions you accepted or rejected.
**Style profile.** Editing preferences we infer from how you work, such as preferred pace, fonts, target platforms and the type of content you make. See section 7.

**Plan and billing.** Your plan, subscription status, usage counters (for example AI operations used this month) and the customer and subscription identifiers sent by our payment provider. We do not receive or store your card details.

**Technical data.** Server logs (time, request, account identifier), error reports from the app (error message, browser type, page), and, only if you accept it, a masked replay of the screen when an error occurs (see the [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy)). Our hosting providers may record IP addresses in their access logs.
**Emails.** Which service emails we sent you and whether you unsubscribed from product updates.
**Before you sign up.** You can try the editor without an account. Your project then stays in your browser. Our server keeps only a temporary session identifier, valid for 48 hours.

sections.title: 4. How the AI features use your content
blocks: When you use a feature that needs it, the relevant part of your content is sent to an AI provider and the result comes back to us:

list: **Transcription and speaker separation:** the audio track is sent to AssemblyAI, Groq or OpenAI, or processed on servers we operate.
**Understanding your requests:** the text of your request, along with the transcript and the project details the assistant needs, is sent to Groq or OpenAI.
**Visual analysis:** still frames taken from your video are sent to Google (Gemini) or OpenAI, for example to describe scenes or pick b-roll.
**Subject cut-outs:** a temporary private link to the video is sent to Replicate to separate a person from the background.
**Searching our media library:** your search text is sent to OpenAI to find matching assets.

blocks: Only what the feature needs is sent. Providers process it under their business API terms and do not keep it longer than those terms allow. We do not use your content to train AI models.

**Faces and voices.** Some features detect where faces are in the frame (to keep them in view when reframing) or which voice is speaking (to label speakers in a transcript). This is not used to recognize who a person is, and it does not identify anyone across different videos.
**Automated decisions.** None of this leads to a decision that has legal or similarly significant effects on you. The AI suggests edits; you decide what to keep.

sections.title: 5. Who processes your data
blocks: Your data is accessible only to us and to the service providers below, each limited to its task and bound by a data processing agreement. Polar acts on its own account as the seller of your subscription (merchant of record).

head: Provider
Role
Location
rows: AI language and vision models, search
Payments, as merchant of record (with Stripe)

blocks: We never sell or rent your data, and we do not share it with advertisers.

sections.title: 6. Transfers outside the European Union
blocks: Some providers above are located outside the EU, or are companies that may access data from outside it. Switzerland benefits from an adequacy decision of the European Commission. For the United States and Türkiye, transfers rely on the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission, or on the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework when the provider is certified under it, together with the provider's security measures.
You can ask us for a copy of the safeguards that apply to a given provider by writing to [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}).

sections.title: 7. Your style profile
blocks: Vibed learns from how you edit (for example, whether you usually remove silences or add captions) to make its suggestions fit your habits. This is a form of profiling under the GDPR, limited to adjusting suggestions inside the editor.
On the [Your style](/style) page you can see this profile, download it as a JSON file or delete it. Deleting it does not affect your projects. You can also object to this processing by writing to us.

blocks: Before a project is deleted for inactivity, we email you at least 24 hours in advance. Opening or editing the project before the date keeps it.

When you delete a project or your account, the data is removed from our database and storage straight away. Copies may remain in our database provider's backups for a short time (up to 30 days) until those backups are overwritten.

sections.title: 9. Your rights
blocks: Under the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act, you can:

list: access your data and get a copy of it;
restrict how we use it in some cases;
object to processing based on our legitimate interest, including your style profile and product emails;
receive the data you gave us in a reusable format (portability);
withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting what was done before;
give instructions on what should happen to your data after your death.

blocks: Several of these are available directly in the app: delete a project from the dashboard, delete your account from the [account page](/auth), manage your style profile on [Your style](/style), unsubscribe from the link in any product email, and change your cookie choice from the footer. For anything else, write to [{{email}}](mailto:{{email}}). We reply within one month. We may ask you to confirm your identity if we have a reasonable doubt about it.

If you think we have not handled your data properly, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority: [www.cnil.fr](https://www.cnil.fr), 3 place de Fontenoy, TSA 80715, 75334 Paris Cedex 07. We would appreciate the chance to sort it out with you first.

sections.title: 10. Security
blocks: All traffic is encrypted (HTTPS). Your files are stored in a private bucket and are only served to your own signed-in account, through a check on our servers. Passwords are hashed. Access to production systems is limited to us.
No system is free of risk. If a breach affected your data and was likely to put your rights at risk, we would notify the CNIL within 72 hours and inform you without undue delay.

sections.title: 11. Cookies and similar technologies
blocks: We use only what the service needs to work, plus one optional error replay tool that requires your consent. The details are in the [Cookie Policy](/cookie-policy).

sections.title: 12. Business contacts
blocks: We sometimes contact professionals (creators, agencies, studios) whose contact details are publicly available in a professional context, to present Vibed. We keep their name, professional email, company and the public source of the information, based on our legitimate interest in business development. Every message lets you object, and we then stop all contact. Without a reply, we delete these details 3 years after the last contact.

sections.title: 13. Children
blocks: Vibed is not intended for children. You must be at least 16 to create an account. If you believe a child has given us personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 14. Changes to this policy
blocks: We update this policy when the service or the law changes. The date at the top shows the latest version. If a change affects how we use your data in a significant way, we will tell you by email or in the app before it applies.
